answer_text:
The two points are

\[
P_0(1,2) \quad \text{and} \quad P_1(3,2).
\]

First, compute the slope:

\[
m=\frac{y_1-y_0}{x_1-x_0}=\frac{2-2}{3-1}=0.
\]

A slope of \(0\) means the line is horizontal. Since both points have \(y=2\), the equation of the line is

\[
\boxed{y=2}
\]
